# Data Dictionary

## Source and licence
* **Source:** generated by `src/generate_synthetic_data.py` (seed 42). Not a real company, customers or sales.
* **Licence:** the generator code is yours to licence (e.g. MIT). The generated data has no third-party rights attached. Brand names are fictional; city and state names are real places used only as geography labels.
* **Using a real dataset instead:** see `data/README.md`. Check the dataset's licence before publishing it.

## Raw file: `data/raw/superstore_synthetic_raw.csv` (8,747 rows)
| Column | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Row ID | integer | Unique line number |
| Order ID | text | Order identifier, e.g. `US-2022-100001`. One order has 1-7 lines |
| Order Date / Ship Date | text | Mostly `YYYY-MM-DD`; about 3% are `DD-Mon-YYYY` |
| Ship Mode | text | Standard Class, Second Class, First Class, Same Day |
| Customer ID / Customer Name | text | Customer key and name |
| Segment | text | Consumer, Corporate, Home Office |
| Country, State, City | text | Ship-to location |
| Postal Code | text | 5-digit ZIP; leading zeros lost in the raw file |
| Region | text | West, East, Central, South |
| Product ID / Product Name | text | Product key and name |
| Category / Sub-Category | text | 3 categories, 17 sub-categories |
| Sales | number | Line revenue **after** discount (USD); negative for returns |
| Quantity | integer | Units; negative for returns |
| Discount | number | Fraction 0-1 (0.2 = 20%) |
| Profit | number | Line profit (USD) = sales minus unit cost x quantity |

## Clean file: `data/processed/superstore_clean.csv` (8,679 rows)
Same fields in snake_case (`order_id`, `sub_category`, ...) plus:
| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| ship_days | Ship date minus order date, in days (blank when the ship date was invalid) |
| profit_margin | Line profit / line sales (for line-level charts only; never average it) |
| year, month | From order date |
| is_return | 1 = legitimate return (negative quantity and sales) |
| is_price_outlier | 1 = implied unit price more than 5x the product's median |
| ship_date_invalid | 1 = source ship date was before the order date and was blanked |

## Star schema (`data/processed/star/`, `sql/schema.sql`)
Grain of `fact_sales`: **one order line**.

| Table | Rows | Key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| dim_customer | 754 | customer_key | customer_id, customer_name, segment |
| dim_product | 174 | product_key | product_id, product_name, category, sub_category |
| dim_geography | 72 | geography_key | country, state, region, city, postal_code (several ZIPs per city; 'Unknown' when missing) |
| dim_date | 1,826 | date_key (YYYYMMDD) | Every day 2022-01-01 to 2026-12-31 |
| fact_sales | 8,679 | row_id | order_id (not unique), order_date_key, ship_date_key (nullable), ship_mode, ship_days, FKs, sales, quantity, discount, profit, three flag columns |

## Known limitations
* Synthetic: relationships such as discount-to-profit are partly built in by the simulator.
* No cost, inventory, return-reason or customer-contact fields. Profit cannot be split into price and cost effects.
* One country, one currency, four years (2022-2025).
* `Sales` is net of discount. Pre-discount list price is derived (`sales / (quantity x (1 - discount))`), not stored.
* Returns are modelled as adjustment lines booked on the original order date and order ID.
